dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY copybooks like COMMON-SPA, CPDBKANRI.INC, CPMSTKANRI.INC, MCPAREA, MCPDATA.INC, ENUM-VALUE, CPORCSGETTEMP.INC

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software - master management update file creation processing
purpose.summary: This program (ORCXRMST3) is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It reads a parameter input file listing master record versions, compares them against DB management and master management table versions, and writes an output file listing masters that need updating. It also updates the master management table (tbl_mstkanri) in the database for records that have been flagged for update.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with PARA-REC (called as subprogram)
SEARCH with INDEXED BY (table search for DBR version)
STRING with DELIMITED BY for file path construction
COPY copybooks with grpsys conditional prefix
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses MCP (middleware) DB access pattern
MCP-TABLE / MCP-PATHNAME pattern for database access
OCCURS 100 INDEXED DBR-IDX table for master version tracking
verdict.notes: Source contains Japanese EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoded comments rendered as Latin-1 mojibake. The 'grpsys' prefix on some COPY and MOVE lines appears to be a conditional compilation tag or group system marker used in the ORCA build system. File truncated at 16000 chars but sufficient content visible for classification.
